title: Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas
author: Hunter S. Thompson
summary: A journalist and his lawyer drive to Las Vegas on a assignment fuelled by a trunk full of drugs. Thompson turns the trip into a wild, semi-fictional satire of the American dream.
readIf: you like savage, chaotic comic writing and gonzo journalism.
skipIf: you dislike drug-soaked narratives or an unstructured, rambling story.
